title: Update exports and implement to_superpauli
description: Update the __all__ list to include 'to_superpauli' and 'superpauli_to_super'. Implement the public to_superpauli function that converts a superoperator from column-stacking basis to Pauli basis. This function should leverage the existing _to_superpauli internal function but provide proper public documentation with full docstring. The function should accept a Qobj representing a quantum map (superoperator, Choi matrix, or unitary operator) and return a Qobj representing the same map in the Pauli basis. It should validate that the input has qubit dimensions.
expected_output: Updated __all__ list containing 'to_superpauli' and 'superpauli_to_super', and a public function with signature to_superpauli(q_oper: Qobj) -> Qobj with comprehensive docstring documenting parameters, returns, raises, and examples.
